definitions.gloss: to sue, to take to court
definitions.explanation: To bring a legal case against someone.
To make an earnest request or express grievances.

examples.japanese: {裁判所|さいばんしょ}に{訴|うった}える。
{不当|ふとう}な{扱|あつか}いを{訴|うった}えた。
{平和|へいわ}を{訴|うった}える。

notes:
{訴|うった}える means to sue or appeal.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xを{訴|うった}える: to complain about X
- Xに{訴|うった}える: to appeal to X
- {裁判|さいばん}に{訴|うった}える: to take to court

RELATED:
- {訴|うった}え: appeal, complaint
- {訴訟|そしょう}: lawsuit
